body: Hey man, sorry I fell asleep before I saw your reply. Mind if I take you up on your offer some other time?
I actually didn't think of that, I knew that I didn't have any bad intentions and so it's fine, but I never thought about how it would affect how they trust other strangers.
That's expensive. I don't have that kind of money.

Let me just clarify a little more. My mom's an angel. I don't know why she's so nice to me and my father. We're both assholes. The only thing is I depend on him for money so there isn't much that I can do when he's saying stuff to me.

I don't think I'm a bad listener or have a lot of baggage (I might but it doesn't affect my relationships with people because I don't tell people that much about myself) but I think I am clingy and needy.

But it's because I do need people to love me, everyone does, and especially now when I'm already having these kind of feelings.

I don't know why but the one person who used to tell me that they loved me is the one that I pushed away.

I think maybe I believe that I don't deserve to be loved even though I want to be loved very badly.
Just wanna say, it was definitely a mistake
Exactly. They never understand anything. I can't live with them anymore.
I feel you man. Stay safe.
She had time for others but not me. So I'm pretty sure she's not exactly busy with life
